title: Goals after Barrows gloves
seoTitle: What to Do After Barrows Gloves: Ironman Goals (OSRS Step 2.0)
description: End-game progression goals including Song of the Elves, Dragon Slayer 2, and Corrupted Gauntlet.

steps.text: Get autoweed perk from Tithe farm (if 54 farming), herb sack IMO isn't even worth getting nowadays with everything giving more herbs and seeds than you'd ever need
Start doing farming contracts as soon as you can do medium contracts, very important!! You can use garden pies to get mediums at 62farm, and hards at 82. Pies can be bought from Cooking guild
If you ever need something AFK to do, just go to ammonite crabs with either bone cbow if you want to catch less chins in the future, or melee them to speed up slayer
steps.updateNote: Scurrius (Jan 2024, Varrock Sewers) beats crabs for mid-level melee if you're playing actively - better XP/hr plus rat bone weapons and useful drops. Crabs remain the pick when you actually want AFK.

steps.text: Get 61 Crafting
Go to the desert quarry and mine sandstone for 1.2k buckets of sand
steps.note: Walk from the rocks to the grinder to maintain run energy if you're 3-ticking

steps.text: Go to rogues' den and burn giant seaweed on the fire, 4 seaweed at a time
Make molten glass at Edgeville furnace
Blow glass lenses, might as well do it underwater again for more seaweed spores
Get 70 mining and do Lunar's diplomacy
steps.note: Only 60 mining is needed for now so you can do this in bits if you want to, but i'd recommend 70 for making friends with my arm (Req 72mining but u can boost with dwarven stout(m) which u should have in bank) and to complete fremmy hard diary very early for the herb patch shortcut. In my opinion the best way to do this is to fill the sandstone grinder with 25k buckets worth of sand to have it ready for later, bring 8 waterskins, drop them as they empty for inv space and then do a birdhouse run. Finish 70 with your favorite mining method

steps.text: Get a helm of neitiznot
Get a fighter torso from BA
Strength amulet is as good as a glory ammy for melee slayer (sometimes even better) so just use that for now
Do slayer until 65 attack and 65 str, if you don't have them already
Get a dragon defender
steps.note: Train defense to 60 while getting defenders

steps.text: Prioritize STR training during slayer, I like to go for 65/80/65 melee stats and from there just train each skill 5 levels before switching to the next
If you completed Defender of Varrock in section 1.5 and have 65 Attack, the Zombie Axe is available as a strong melee weapon
steps.note: Zombie Axe (65 Attack) - the broken zombie axe drops from Armoured Zombies in Zemouregal's Base (the dungeon from Defender of Varrock); repair it at an anvil with 70 Smithing. A strong slash weapon that bridges the gap before the Abyssal Whip.

steps.text: Get 58 slayer, make sure you're consistent with all your farming and birdhouses
steps.note: Personally I like to do Turael point boosting until around 150 tasks, every 10th task from Konar just to get all the good unlocks and blocklist sorted before doing normal slayer, but you can do slayer however you like

steps.text: I recommend doing hard clues, they're good gp/h at this point of the account. Train crafting for blue dhide if you get those steps using the superglass make lunar spell
Prioritize slayer points on: Superior slayer > Blocklist > Extend your favorite tasks > Slay ring > Slay helm > Garg smasher
steps.updateNote: Updated priority (wiki ironman Slayer guide): spend points on blocks and skips first, then perks like Bigger and Badder (superiors, 50 points since August 2025) and extensions. Each Slayer master now keeps its own block list, so build one for the master you actually use. See our ironman Slayer guide for the full block list and unlock order.

steps.text: At 58 slayer: Camp Cave horrors for mask
If you have around 65/80/65 melee stats now, do Making friends with my arm quest and make both of the basalt tele portals in your POH
steps.note: The quest can be done with lower stats, but the boss can be annoying if you're not hitting well

steps.text: Do Fremmy hard diary, get 70 agility and make few agility pots to use the shortcut to speed up your herb runs even more, drink the boost before using the teleport to skip the shortcut
Do dream mentor and imbue your mask
Get crafting level for slayer rings at some point
Keep doing slayer until level 75
steps.note: If you want to boost brews from ToB for Song of the elves you can stop at around 70slay, whenever u have 70herb banked. You can go for a B ring during a dagannoth task if you want, 70def with full rune is decent for camping Rex

steps.text: Do Mage arena 2
Get 77 herblore, you should have it banked by now if you've been farming, if you don't then just keep doing more slayer
steps.note: You can finish all the quests that give herb xp or lamps, some hard diaries can also be done

steps.text: Get 70 agility if you didn't get it for the herb patch shortcut earlier
Cut and bank 2.2k teak logs at fossil island, from the farming patch teaks
Do Mahogany homes with teak planks for 70 construction
Finish 70 woodcutting with any method
Get 60 range with bone crossbow at pest control if you haven't already got 60
Get 70 smithing
steps.note: If you can't afford to do it all with gold, you can buy like 2k coal and 2k iron and make steel platebodies. Steel is a bit slower but you profit GP from it so it's still a decent method. If you don't care about rushing DS2 and Sote, just go do more slayer until you can afford to do 70 smithing with gold only
steps.updateNote: Giants' Foundry (unlocked via Sleeping Giants at step 1.1.145a) supersedes steel platebodies entirely: 85-135k Smithing XP/hr depending on level, profitable rather than break-even, and it awards the Smiths' Uniform for bonus XP. Take your bars there instead.

steps.text: Make botanical pies and +4 herblore boost for sara brews
Do Song of the elves
steps.note: If you don't have 80 magic yet for blitz, you could go do MTA for B2P, master wand and inf boots. Use blood blitz against Seren. If you go in with inventory full of brews and restores, it's basically impossible to fail the fight

steps.text: Hunt 15k red chins at the Prif hunter area
Get range void from PC
Unlock MM2 chinning area and chin to at least 87 range
steps.note: At 70 range, if you're 100cb do western hard diary and upgrade to elite void

steps.text: Do Dragon slayer 2
Start using kingdom again now that you'll be getting constant GP easily, put it on 10 teaks or mahogany, whichever you prefer to use for construction and 5 on herbs
Ending the guide here, you can pretty much do whatever you want from here
Moons of Peril: Farm Blue Moon boss first for its magic-oriented hybrid armour, then Blood Moon for the melee set (requires Perilous Moons quest)
steps.note: Blue Moon magic armour (+30 magic attack body, +22 legs) is needed as gear for Royal Titans. Blood Moon melee set is strong for Slayer. Prioritize Blue Moon first, then Blood Moon. Come back with Bowfa after CG if needed to finish the melee set.

steps.text: Farm Royal Titans for Twinflame Staff, Deadeye and Mystic Vigour prayer scrolls (no quest required, duo recommended)
steps.note: Royal Titans is a duo boss accessible at ~90 combat with no quest requirements. Use Blue Moon magic armour for the fight. Priority drops: Fire/Ice element staff crown (1/75 each) for the Twinflame Staff (60 Magic; fires a second hit at 40% damage on elemental spells, excluding Strike/Surge; outperforms Trident of the Seas until ~92 Magic), Deadeye scroll (62 Prayer, +18% ranged attack/damage - replaces Eagle Eye), Mystic Vigour scroll (63 Prayer, +18% magic attack/defence +3% magic damage - replaces Mystic Might). These prayers help at Corrupted Gauntlet and all subsequent PvM. Can be done on a Fire Giant Slayer task for Slayer helm bonus.

steps.text: By far the best thing to do next is to camp Corrupted Gauntlet until 2 enhanced weapon seeds to make both of the weapons and 6 armor seeds for full crystal
Phase 2 Complete: Post-Bowfa progression begins here
steps.note: With Bowfa (c) + Crystal armour, you now have one of the strongest ranged setups in the game. Deadeye and Mystic Vigour prayers from Royal Titans boost all combat going forward. The following steps outline the mid-to-late game gear progression.

steps.text: Resume Slayer with Bowfa - push to 85+ Slayer for boss tasks and Abyssal Demons
steps.note: Bowfa makes many Slayer tasks extremely fast. Camp Abyssal Demons at 85 for the Abyssal Whip.

steps.text: Do Mastering Mixology at 60+ Herblore (requires Children of the Sun)
steps.note: Mastering Mixology in Varlamore is a new Herblore training method that provides good XP rates and useful herblore-related rewards.

steps.text: Start ToA at Entry Mode, push to 150 invocations for unique drops
steps.note: Tombs of Amascut is extremely ironman-friendly with scalable difficulty. Priority drops: Osmumten's Fang (best melee stab weapon), Lightbearer (doubles spec regen), Masori armour. Start at entry mode to learn, then push invocations up.

steps.text: Farm ToA for Osmumten's Fang and Lightbearer as priority drops
steps.note: Fang is BIS melee stab weapon used everywhere. Lightbearer doubles spec regen rate, useful at every boss. Both are common-ish drops relative to other raid uniques.

steps.text: Complete While Guthix Sleeps quest (requires many prerequisites including Defender of Varrock)
steps.note: Reward: fixed XP - 80k Thieving, 75k Farming, 75k Herblore, 50k Hunter, plus Slayer XP (Duradel's notes). One of the largest quest XP rewards in the game. Also unlocks Tormented Demons (Burning claws and the Purging Staff).

steps.text: Complete Secrets of the North quest and farm Phantom Muspah
steps.note: Phantom Muspah drops the Ancient Sceptre upgrade and other useful items. Bowfa is very effective here.

steps.text: Get 77 Herblore for Stamina Potions (if not already from WGS lamps)
steps.note: Stamina Potions are essential for efficient gameplay. If you used WGS lamps on Herblore you may already have this.

steps.text: Complete Desert Treasure II quest
steps.note: Unlocks 4 new bosses: Vardorvis, The Leviathan, The Whisperer, Duke Sucellus. Each drops powerful rings and other uniques. Requires high combat stats and multiple quest prereqs.

steps.text: Farm DT2 bosses: Vardorvis first for Ultor Ring + Soulreaper Axe
steps.note: Vardorvis is commonly the recommended first DT2 boss. It drops the Ultor vestige (made into the Ultor ring, BIS strength ring) and the Executioner's axe head (a Soulreaper Axe component). Do Vardorvis first, then the other DT2 bosses for the Bellator, Magus, and Venator vestiges.

steps.text: GWD: Farm Bandos for melee armour, Armadyl for ranged armour
steps.note: With Bowfa + Crystal armour, Armadyl is very doable. Bandos can be done with Fang or melee setup. Priority: Bandos Chestplate + Tassets, then Armadyl Chestplate + Chainskirt.

steps.text: Craft the Purging Staff from Tormented Demons (requires WGS completion)
steps.note: Tormented Demons drop the Burning claw (two combine into Burning claws, a strong spec weapon) and the Tormented synapse used to build the Purging Staff. (They do not drop Dragon Claws in OSRS.)

steps.text: Fortis Colosseum for Dizana's Quiver (BIS ranged cape)
steps.note: The Colosseum is challenging wave-based content in Varlamore. Dizana's Quiver is the BIS ranged CAPE (it can hold ammunition but occupies the cape slot). Requires strong gear and high combat stats.

steps.text: Nex masses for Torva armour
steps.note: Torva is BIS melee armour. Nex is best done in masses (large groups). Ancient Godsword spec helps with healing.

steps.text: Chambers of Xeric for Twisted Bow, Dragon Hunter Crossbow, and other uniques
steps.note: CoX is the original OSRS raid. Twisted Bow is the most powerful ranged weapon. Also drops Kodai Wand, Dragon Claws, and Ancestral robes. Learn in trios or small teams.

steps.text: Theatre of Blood for Scythe of Vitur, Rapier, and Sanguinesti Staff
steps.note: ToB drops some of the most powerful weapons in the game. Scythe is BIS for large monsters. Rapier is BIS melee stab. Sanguinesti Staff is a strong magic weapon with built-in healing.

steps.text: Begin Yama farming for Oathplate armour (duo recommended, Surge potions are a priority)
steps.note: Yama is a 2025 boss that drops the Oathplate armour set (slash-focused melee) and the Soulflame Horn. Surge potions significantly help with the fight. Duo is recommended for ironmen.

steps.text: Farm Doom of Mokhaiotl delves for Eye of Ayak and Avernic Treads (requires The Final Dawn quest)
steps.note: Doom of Mokhaiotl is accessed through delves after The Final Dawn quest. Eye of Ayak (83 Magic) is the fastest powered staff in the game at 3-tick speed - different niche from Tumeken's Shadow. Avernic Treads are multi-style endgame boots (+4 melee str, +2 ranged str, +1% magic dmg). Scale delve levels for better drop rates (1/2000 at level 3, improving to 1/540 at higher levels).

steps.text: Continue ToA for Masori armour and Tumeken's Shadow
steps.note: Masori (f) is BIS ranged armour. Tumeken's Shadow is arguably the strongest magic weapon. Both are rarer drops so expect a longer grind.
